LightningComponentBundle.description: EOI microsite landing page (hero + footer). Brand set per site in Experience Builder. Author: Aurelix

property.name: modonLogoImage
property.label: MODON logo URL
property.description: White MODON logo in the header band of the project hero layout; blank = none

property.name: heroImageMobile
property.label: Hero image URL (portrait / phones)
property.description: Portrait render served when the viewport is taller than wide; leave blank to use the hero image everywhere

property.name: heroLayout
property.label: Hero layout
property.description: Blank = logo top-centre and button bottom-centre; 'project' = the modon.com project-page hero (stacked logo, heading, tagline, white uppercase button, bottom-left)

property.name: title
property.label: Heading
property.description: Shown under the logo in the 'project' layout; leave blank to hide it

property.name: logoImage
property.label: Logo image URL
property.description: White/light logo shown centred at the top

property.name: beginUrl
property.label: Begin URL
property.description: Relative site URL the button navigates to
